# Innerscape

> Personal growth OS for journaling, emotional check-ins, habits, goals, body logs, decluttering, and self-awareness workflows.

Innerscape is a TypeScript monorepo with a Fastify backend, Expo mobile app, shared types, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and modules for mind, flow, body, hub, decluttering, and trade workflows.

## Use cases
- Personal growth operating system
- Journaling and emotional check-ins
- Habit, goal, task, and dopamine menu tracking
- Sleep logs and somatic mapping
- Decluttering sessions and item decisions
- PARA-style projects, capture inbox, reviews, and knowledge base
- Neurodivergent-friendly self-awareness workflows

## Key paths
- `README.md`: public overview and setup
- `apps/backend/`: Fastify API, Prisma, auth, route modules
- `apps/mobile/`: Expo app with Home, Mind, Flow, Body, and Hub tabs
- `packages/shared/`: shared TypeScript types

## Keywords
personal growth OS, life OS, journaling app, emotional check-in app, habit tracker, goal tracker, neurodivergent productivity, ADHD-friendly planning, decluttering app, Expo app, Fastify API, Prisma PostgreSQL, TypeScript wellness app.
